english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial pattern for compounds such as 口水腺 when relating something to saliva.

examples.english: The doctor says my salivary glands are inflamed, so my mouth is always dry.
examples.traditional: 醫生話我口水腺發炎，所以成日口乾。
